newsitem.title: NORWAY: SOCCER-PORTO SNATCH LAST MINUTE WIN OVER ROSENBORG.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PORTO SNATCH LAST MINUTE WIN OVER ROSENBORG.

text.p: Brazilian substitute Jardel struck in the last minute to maintain Porto's 100 percent record in group D of the European champions' league on Wednesday.
The Portuguese champions beat 10-man Rosenborg of Norway 1-0. Jardel slotted home a headed pass from compatriot Edmilson following a corner.

The Norwegian champions paid the ultimate penalty for failing to put away several good chances in the second half. Porto goalkeeper Hilario kept his side from falling behind in the 71st minute when he blocked a powerful shot from midfielder Trond Soltvedt.
Rosenborg striker Jahn Ivar Jakobsen was sent off in the 75th minute for protesting against the referee's decision and earning his second yellow card.
